description.value: On The Way is a small but well-stocked convenience and outdoor supply store that has served the Chilliwack River Valley for over 40 years, now run by owners Lorne and Mary Grove since 2018. Positioned along Chilliwack Lake Road, it functions as a one-stop resupply point for anglers, campers, and hikers heading into the valley, carrying groceries, hardware, camping gear, fishing tackle, ice, and firewood. Historical photographs from the early 1980s line the walls, and a hot dog stand operates right next door.
